entities.summary: Antonius Theodorus Colenbrander was a Dutch horse rider. He competed at the 1924 Summer Olympics in the three-days event and at the 1928 Summer Olympics in jumping and won a gold medal with the Dutch team in 1924. He died after a bad fall from his horse at a jumping competition in Zelhem.
